workflows.name: publish-plugin
workflows.fallback: Run scripts/marketplace directly from the marketplace repository.

workflows.name: session-learning
workflows.fallback: Export or supply the source session explicitly and maintain the resulting plugin with the portable publish workflow.

workflows.name: scheduled-automation
workflows.fallback: Use the host scheduler and reporting tools directly; Loom's bundled runner currently invokes Claude Code.

waiver.rationale: Loom's session ingestion and unattended runner depend on Claude Code transcript, hook, and CLI contracts; marketplace publishing is already portable.
waiver.missingCapability: A host-neutral supplied-session import format and runner adapter for Codex.
waiver.fallback: Use publish-plugin on either host; run harvest, learning, and scheduled automation from Claude Code until the adapter ships.
waiver.exitCriteria: Codex can ingest an explicit session bundle, run the learning loop without Claude transcript paths, and pass an isolated automation fixture.
